verification.description: For generated output lengths around and above a random small max_output_chars (stdlib random, seeded), assert the stored length is min(len, N), the stored value is a suffix of the original, and the flag equals len > N.
evidence: pytest tests: 158 passed (run_quality.py full suite 2026-11-05, agent-work/quality-results.json)
